name: pr-reply-assistant
description: Instantly generate context-aware replies to pull request comments using AI.

chatParticipants.name: prreply
chatParticipants.description: Draft concise, constructive replies for pull request comments.

prReplyAssistant.modelId.description: Preferred language model id used when drafting replies. Leave empty to auto-select. Set during onboarding.

prReplyAssistant.modelFamily.description: Fallback model family used when the saved model id is no longer available (e.g. after a Copilot model rename). Set during onboarding.

prReplyAssistant.modelVendor.description: Fallback model vendor (e.g. 'copilot'). Set during onboarding.

prReplyAssistant.promptForModelSelection.description: Ask to select a model each time. When false, the model from `prReplyAssistant.modelId` is used silently.

prReplyAssistant.persistSelectedModel.description: When the model selection prompt is enabled, persist the selected model as preferred.

prReplyAssistant.language.description: Language used for the draft reply. Free text — e.g. 'English', 'Türkçe', 'Español'. Set during onboarding.

enumDescriptions: Standard: planner gathers context on demand. Fast.
Deep: pre-seeds available-change diagnostics and detailed diffs into the evidence pack. Slower, broader.
prReplyAssistant.contextDepth.description: How much context to pre-seed before the agent pipeline runs.

prReplyAssistant.tone.description: Default tone preset for draft replies.

prReplyAssistant.strategy.description: Default reply strategy. 'auto' lets the agents decide based on evidence.

prReplyAssistant.askForExtraInstructions.description: Show a small input box for optional extra guidance each time the draft button is clicked. When false, the draft starts immediately.

enumDescriptions: Copy or stream only the reply text.
Include the reply plus strategy and confidence.
Include full diagnostic metadata, including planner/critic/token details.
prReplyAssistant.outputDetail.description: How much metadata to include in visible draft output. Full diagnostics are always kept in the Output panel.

prReplyAssistant.personalToneExamples.description: Optional examples of your previous PR replies. The assistant uses these only as style guidance and should not copy private details or exact phrasing.

prReplyAssistant.onboardingComplete.description: Internal flag indicating whether the first-time onboarding has been completed.

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
